title: Thermographic evaluation of the breast during hypofractionated radiotherapy
summary: In this study, temperature changes in the irradiated and contralateral breast are monitored using a contactless thermal imaging camera (thermography) during adjuvant hypofractionated radiotherapy in breast cancer patients. The examinations are performed regularly before and during treatment using CE-certified devices. The aim is to detect radiation-induced skin and tissue changes at an early stage in a non-invasive and gentle manner.

interventions.name: Measurements of breast temperatures in the ipsilateral and contralateral breasts. Patients will undergo thermographic examinations on Days 1, 6, 11, and 16 (during radiotherapy), as well as on Days 21 and 26, and approximately 3 months after completion of radiotherapy (follow-up).
